# Vendored tarball

`viell-effect-schema-http-0.1.0-beta.1.tgz` was produced by `pnpm pack` against commit
`d2b0930e285d092b5cd32c788dba9ff74d5bb81c` of the `repo` library
(`../../repo` relative to this workspace, i.e. `../Libraries/Effect Schema HTTP/repo` from here),
following the "Trying the beta" instructions in that project's README. It is installed by the
`server` and `web` packages as a `file:` dependency pointing at this tarball, matching the
library's documented beta-distribution flow (no registry package exists yet).
